methodology: Repository-wide extraction of persisted MetaPleno near-pleno/full events. Events are deduplicated by date+winning+pool+hits. No inference from summary counters. Cross-family rescue means the missing winner from one persisted 5/6 pool was independently present in another persisted pool on the same date; exploratory only because source families were developed sequentially.

support.family: Compact non-algebraic hazard family. Per-number features: short/long frequency, transition likelihood conditioned on prior draw overlap, gap, repeat/repeat2, number position/parity/low-high. 200,000 deterministic specifications sharded; cheap screen on deterministic subset of 2020-2022, global rerank on all 2020-2022, top100 frozen, then 2023-2024 and 2025-latest opened without reranking.

Pattern-Atlas structural conformal reranker. Hyperparameter lambda selected on discovery only. Each pre-draw prediction uses only prior winning combinations. Candidate pools are deterministic one-swap variants of the base top8 frontier; structural nonconformity uses sum, range, parity, consecutive count, decade concentration and gap dispersion.

Exploratory cross-family deduplicated near-pleno audit of two discovery-selected leaders: v123 c12 and v128 structural lambda leader. Null is deliberately conservative: each draw is assigned probability 2*q for >=5 in either pool, where q is exact fair-draw probability for one fixed 8-number pool; this upper-bounds union probability even if pools overlap. Because this cross-family combination was examined after seeing family results, the p-value is exploratory and not a confirmatory promotion test.

Pattern-Atlas structural conformal reranker. Hyperparameter lambda selected on discovery only. Each pre-draw prediction uses only prior winning combinations. Candidate pools are deterministic one-swap variants of the base top8 frontier; structural nonconformity uses sum, range, parity, consecutive count, decade concentration and gap dispersion.

Exploratory cross-family deduplicated near-pleno audit of two discovery-selected leaders: v123 c12 and v128 structural lambda leader. Null is deliberately conservative: each draw is assigned probability 2*q for >=5 in either pool, where q is exact fair-draw probability for one fixed 8-number pool; this upper-bounds union probability even if pools overlap. Because this cross-family combination was examined after seeing family results, the p-value is exploratory and not a confirmatory promotion test.
